Durable state and publication subsystem
|
|-- SQL: session aggregate survives inactive execution and restart
|   |-- SessionTable: sessionID, project and location identity
|   |   |-- agent / model / permissions / metadata / revert / usage / times
|   |   |-- parent_id: child-session relationship
|   |   |-- fork_session_id + fork_boundary: separate fork provenance
|   |   `-- time_suspended: execution claim; resume_attempts: retry budget
|   |-- SessionMessageTable: ordered messages
|   |   `-- SessionPartTable: text / reasoning / tool calls and results
|   |-- SessionInboxTable: durable pending work
|   |   |-- steer: eligible during continuation
|   |   `-- queue: next-turn boundary; compaction/move: control items
|   `-- InstructionStateTable + InstructionEntryTable: durable instructions
|
|-- Bus: shared event publication and observation
|   |-- Durable publication transaction
|   |   |-- -> registered SessionProjector handlers
|   |   |-- Aggregate sequence + projections + optional commit callback
|   |   `-- EventTable payload retention only when persist is enabled
|   `-- After commit -> volatile live subscribers
|-- SessionProjector: registered projection handlers
|   `-- SessionMessageUpdater folds step/text/reasoning/tool events
|       `-- -> SQL messages and parts
|-- SessionInbox: admission and lifecycle operations -> Bus + SQL
`-- SessionStore: get / messages / context over projected SQL
    `-- Same durable state serves API readers and runner requests
